description:
You are a District Surveillance Officer in Bombali. You need to generate a line listing report for the 'Child Programme' to audit enrollments. 

Using DHIS2 (http://localhost:8080, admin/district):
1. Open the 'Event Reports' app (or 'Line Listing' app).
2. Create a Line List report for the 'Child Programme'.
3. Select 'Bombali' district as the Organisation Unit.
4. Select '2023' (or the last 12 months) as the Period.
5. Add at least 3 data columns (data elements or attributes) to the report.
6. Save the report as a favorite with the name: 'Bombali Child Programme Line List 2023'.
7. Export/Download the report data (CSV or Excel) to /home/ga/Downloads/.
